sources.snippet: About This Release RANGER™ CONSTRUCTION INTELLIGENCE is open-sourcing the RANGER™ Heavy Equipment Detection Model for learning, evaluation, and non-commercial use by the Hong Kong construction industry, academic institutions, and research teams.

sources.title: Machinery Computer Vision Datasets and Models - Roboflow
sources.snippet: By monitoring construction sites one can increase safety on-site. An example of computer vision in machinery includes detecting cranes, bulldozers, and excavators in order to prevent injuries during the work day.

sources.title: Ranger Core API - Ranger Documentation - cmu-sei.github.io
sources.snippet: Ranger Core API The Ranger Core API is the main service endpoint that handles incoming requests, coordinates system components, and integrates with a language model backend. It does not contain the AI model itself — rather, it serves as the central controller that routes messages, invokes tools, and returns results.

sources.title: SiteAI Equipment Tracker — YOLOv8 Deployment - GitHub
sources.snippet: Manual equipment tracking is error-prone and cannot scale across large AECO projects. This project develops a computer vision system that automatically detects and classifies 7 types of heavy construction equipment from site photographs, enabling real-time monitoring for safety and logistics.
